verdict.rationale: Lithic's Events API lets users register and manage webhook URLs, control event subscription secrets, replay webhook messages, and search past events. It also uses HMAC-signed headers and has a sandbox that runs webhooks end-to-end, so event subscriptions are a clearly documented first-party capability. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery, and documentation detail on the event-type catalog and per-subscription filtering.
